workstreams.name: Ethics Boundary Enforcement
workstreams.kpi_target: 100% high-risk surfaces have disclosure + review requirement

items.title: Create shared RegulatorySafetyNotice component
acceptance: Component adopted by assistant, insight cards, and top 5 prediction surfaces
Design tokens standardized for warning severity tiers

items.title: Standardize AIResponseMetadata contract
acceptance: Responses include aiGenerated/model/qualityTier/reviewRequired
Contract tests fail on missing required fields

items.title: Confidence-class labels for prediction surfaces
acceptance: Low/Medium/High confidence classes visible in all risk cards

items.title: Inventory and risk-tier all export endpoints
acceptance: Registry includes route, owner, risk tier, gate status

items.title: Unify governance middleware across exports
acceptance: All regulated export routes require governance middleware
Middleware emits consistent governance headers

items.title: Add immutable reviewer evidence record
acceptance: Reviewer snapshot hash + timestamp stored
Approval reason mandatory for high-risk exports

items.title: Bind e-signature to export manifest
acceptance: Manifest contains signature linkage and verification hash

items.title: Canonical router decision RFC
acceptance: Single routing authority documented and approved

items.title: Emit fallback telemetry in API + logs
acceptance: provider/model/attemptedProviders/qualityTier emitted per request

items.title: Persist policy state (rate/health/circuit/budget)
acceptance: Restart preserves provider health and budget windows

items.title: Risk-tier downgrade policy
acceptance: Downgrade behavior configurable by risk tier: block/warn/confirm

workstreams.name: Automated Validation Gates
workstreams.kpi_target: >99% high-risk CI gate pass rate on main

items.title: Export gate integration tests
acceptance: Approved/unapproved export behavior verified for all formats

items.title: AI metadata contract tests
acceptance: Build fails if required AI metadata fields are missing

items.title: Prompt-injection regression suite
acceptance: OWASP LLM payload set integrated in CI

items.title: Provider failover schema tests
acceptance: Malformed fallback output is rejected/retried as designed

items.title: Define DomainPack interface
acceptance: Interface published with ontology/risk/evidence/benchmark contracts

items.title: Refactor life-sciences pack
acceptance: Life-sciences rules run through DomainPack contract

items.title: Pilot autonomous-vehicles pack (advisory-only)
acceptance: AV pilot passes baseline uncertainty and policy checks

program_risks.risk: Inconsistent governance across long-tail export routes
program_risks.mitigation: Route inventory + centralized middleware + CI coverage

program_risks.risk: Silent model-quality downgrade in high-risk workflows
program_risks.mitigation: Fallback telemetry + downgrade policy + gating by risk tier

program_risks.risk: Reviewer evidence not strong enough for audit defense
program_risks.mitigation: Immutable review evidence + optional signature binding
